verdict_reason: Acceptance element 1 fails: of the three downstream inputs the work item names (shot-planner, storyboard, music-request), two have zero production consumers at head_sha, and the third carries only pace_order + true_at_beat. method_plan.shot_seeds, method_plan.storyboard_input, method_plan.music_request_input and method_plan.production_map are unreferenced by any stage; their only non-own reference is a callable()-name probe in package/999_adapter.py.

acceptance_results.element: Blueprint fields populate actual downstream inputs
evidence: shot_seeds: 0 production consumers. Full-tree walk of 75-drama-song-ad-factory (*.py, owner module + its own tests excluded) finds only package/999_adapter.py:578-579, which builds the tuple ("validate", ..., "shot_seeds", "storyboard_input", "music_request_input", "production_map", ...) and checks callable(getattr(plan, s, None)) at line 580. It never calls them.

shot-planner input is unwired: scripts/core/shot_planner/shot_planner.py does not import method_plan, and its real entry is bind_plan(shots, timing, contracts=None, chosen_length_s=None) over SHOT_FIELDS (shot_planner.py:24-44, 191).

storyboard_input: 0 production consumers. The storyboard review reads its own artifacts: storyboard_director/approval_runner.py:222-227 loads storyboard/shot-list.json + storyboard/contracts.json + storyboard/stills.json and does not import method_plan.
storyboard/shot-list.json is a declared artifact path only (production_process.py:438, factory.py:1834); no code writes it from creative/blueprint.json.
music_request_input: 0 consumers. The real music path is music_director.blueprint_request_inputs -> _blueprint_turns, which re-derives the four turns independently of method_plan.musical_turns.

What IS wired: factory._pace_into_music (intake_preflight/factory.py:1635-1668) calls method_plan.pace_order and writes pace_order + true_at_beat into $RUN/music/req.json; music_director reads both (music_director/__init__.py:512, 538). music_qc.pace_change.check_pace_plan accepts the order with 0 errors.

SKILL.md:1560-1561 states 'shot_seeds emits shot_planner's own field names and storyboard_input feeds the storyboard review'. The first half is a field-name claim; the second half is false at head_sha.

acceptance_results.element: Every required musical turn carries a recorded reason plus intended audible change
acceptance_results.caveat: Holds in the owned projection and in the recorded stage block, NOT in the provider music request (see finding F3).
evidence: method_plan.musical_turns (method_plan.py:227) returns 4 turns; 4 of 4 carry a non-empty reason, 4 of 4 carry a non-empty audible_change (checks C2).
validate() embeds the turns in its report (method_plan.py:646) and factory._method_plan_block stores that report as blueprint_check in the stage data (factory.py:1628, 2693, 2850).

Enforced, not decorative: tampering SOLUTION_HOOK.trigger + SB-07.why_it_belongs raises TURN_REASON_MISSING; blanking ERM_DROP pace_after/rhythmic_change/emotional_direction raises TURN_AUDIBLE_CHANGE_MISSING; blanking BASELINE.lyric_or_dialogue raises ATTENTION_HOOK_NOT_SPOKEN (checks C3).
Caveat measured: music_director.blueprint_request_inputs(bp) returns 4 turns with reason present on 0 of 4 and audible-change fields on 1 of 4 (hero_shift only).
teaching_map returns 12 rows and [r['production_beat'] for r in rows] == list(story_arc.BEATS) with len(story_arc.BEATS) == 12 (checks C1).
method_plan imports BEATS from story_arc (method_plan.py:66) and indexes product_intro from it (method_plan.py:159); it defines no beat list of its own.
Pattern search for five-beat / 5-act schemes across *.py *.md *.json *.sh in the skill: 1 hit, which is method_plan.py:38 stating no five-beat scheme competes. No second engine.
